$comment: Where each fixture in this directory came from, and the exact upstream bytes it is synced to. The blob ids are git object ids of the UPSTREAM files (git hash-object), recorded when the copy was taken. scripts/verify-upstream-fixtures.mjs is what actually checks the claim against a real apatureai/verdict checkout; the offline test in test/golden.test.ts can only check that this repo's copy still hashes to the id recorded here, which is a drift alarm on local edits and is NOT a cross-repo comparison.

upstream.note: verdict produces these results and gate consumes them. All three repositories must hold byte-identical copies; the shape is the cross-repo contract.
